Loading the example explicitly replaces local fictional purchasing, maintenance and work journals after confirmation if they contain records. It creates an approved PO and acceptance; it does not post an invoice or payment. Role selection illustrates responsibility, not authentication.

Three gates before completion.

1 / Linked material acceptance

Check the exact request.

Inspect purchasing and acceptance →

Material readiness comes from the reviewed condition's stable request ID and PO line. A receipt on another purchase does not satisfy this gate. Invoice payment is not a prerequisite for recording work in this scenario.

2 / Maintenance technician

Record the performed task.

A return for rework requires a new completion reference. The source maintenance and accepted-material checkpoints are retained with the recorded action.

3 / Independent verification

Maintenance verifier

The separate fictional observation window is evidence for a manual review. It does not automatically close the case, certify a real repair, or prove avoided failure or savings. Returning a review preserves the previous work version.

Retain the work and the decisions.

Recorded work versions and independent dispositions for this case
Work recordPerformed UTCReference / taskVerification

    Recover and explain the completed trail.

    Work, material and observation boundaries

    One work record identifies one condition case, approved work package, linked request and accepted PO line. Its source checkpoints capture the validated context at execution. One verification decision applies to that exact work version. New work after a returned review retains both versions.

    The verification fixture is a separately invented 10:00–10:30 UTC window on 15 Nov 2026. It contains complete good observations for two assets. Acceptance uses the reviewed asset's 30 minutes of good RUN state and good vibration at or below the fictional teaching threshold, after recorded completion. This is a demonstration policy, not a diagnostic or safety standard.

    Execution and independent verification have their own replayable work journal. Restoring it does not replace purchasing or maintenance journals. Ordinary work/verification actions do not post financial transactions or alter the original machine snapshot. No production permission, control command, actual maintenance or real funds movement is performed.
